title: The Land Nobody Wants
art_style: cute 2D vector sticker illustration, minimalist flat design, chibi proportions, flat colors with no gradients, muted earthy palette, clean dark outline, full body, centered, isolated on a solid plain white background, no text

scenes.narration: This patch of desert is bigger than Hong Kong, and no country on Earth wants it.
It's called Bir Tawil, and it sits right between Egypt and Sudan.
The problem started with two lines, both drawn by the British.
In 1899, the border was a straight line along the twenty-second parallel.
scenes.tts: In eighteen ninety-nine, the border was a straight line along the twenty-second parallel.

scenes.narration: In 1902, they drew a second line for the local tribes. It gave Bir Tawil to Egypt, and a much bigger area, Hala'ib, to Sudan.
scenes.tts: In nineteen-oh-two, they drew a second line for the local tribes. It gave Bir Tawil to Egypt, and a much bigger area, Halaib, to Sudan.

scenes.narration: Here's the trap. Egypt says the first line counts, which gives it Hala'ib. Sudan says the second line counts, which also gives it Hala'ib.
scenes.tts: Here's the trap. Egypt says the first line counts, which gives it Halaib. Sudan says the second line counts, which also gives it Halaib.

scenes.narration: And Hala'ib is about ten times bigger, with a coast on the Red Sea.
scenes.tts: And Halaib is about ten times bigger, with a coast on the Red Sea.

scenes.narration: So claiming Bir Tawil would mean admitting the other line, and losing Hala'ib.
scenes.tts: So claiming Bir Tawil would mean admitting the other line, and losing Halaib.

scenes.narration: That's why nobody claims it. It's one of the only places like this left on the planet.
Of course, people have tried. In 2014, an American dad planted a flag here so his daughter could be a real princess.
scenes.tts: Of course, people have tried. In twenty fourteen, an American dad planted a flag here so his daughter could be a real princess.

icons.ai: a cute cartoon dad planting a small flag in the desert sand next to his little daughter wearing a princess crown
icons.name: triangular flag

scenes.narration: No country recognized it. The desert is still empty.
If you could claim Bir Tawil, what would you name your country?
